Case: Yang is a 44-year-old who presents with 2 months of low-back and leg pain. The pain started after a day of heavy yard work and has progressed gradually over time. You order an MRI, which reveals an L5-S1 disc herniation with associated canal stenosis and left neuroforaminal stenosis.
